title: Retail and Commercial & Industrial Engineer
description:
Retail and Commercial & Industrial Engineer Rubis Kingston and St. Andrew Not disclosed Permanent full-time Updated 02/11/2026 Human Resources Apply Now Share Share this job Facebook Twitter Report This Job Save Save The successful candidate will be responsible for planning and executing Retail Network and commercial CAPEX projects, preventative maintenance activities, 
 and development & construction activities. Job Summary The successful candidate will be responsible for: Planning and executing Retail Network CAPEX projects annually within budgetary and timeline projections. Planning and executing Commercial & Industrial CAPEX projects annually within budgetary and timeline projections. Planning and executing preventative maintenance activities within Rubis Jamaica Network. Successfully deliver assigned Retail/C&I CAPEX projects safely, within approved scope and budget, on schedule, and to defined quality standards, while ensuring effective project governance, contractor management, regulatory compliance, and complete project closeout. Key deliverables will include but are not limited to: Manage the delivery of Retail & Commercial Network CAPEX projects by: o Developing project Scopes of Work, budgets, schedules and procurement requirements. o Issuing scopes to qualified contractors and coordinating responses to technical and commercial queries. o Reviewing contractor proposals and making recommendations for the award of works. o Coordinating project activities from initiation and procurement through construction, commissioning and closeout. Monitor project cost, schedule and progress to ensure projects are delivered in accordance with approved budgets, timelines and scope, including timely capture and reconciliation of project costs. Maintain accurate and complete project records using company systems and software, including project schedules, costs, approvals, contracts, progress updates, quality records and closeout documentation. Coordinate the timely procurement and delivery of equipment, materials and services required for project execution. · Manage and monitor contractors and consultants, including performance, compliance, quality of work, defects, corrective actions and post-project evaluations. · Ensure project works comply with applicable regulatory, company HSE and technical standards, including required permits, Management of Change (MOC), inspections and approvals. · Promote the safe execution of Retail & Commercial Network projects through effective risk management, RAPNET work permitting, toolbox meetings and monitoring of HSE requirements. · Implement project quality requirements, including inspections, testing, hold points, defect management and quality closeout documentation. · Coordinate project commissioning, handover and closeout, ensuring completion of outstanding works, submission of required documentation and timely updating of asset information. · Prepare and maintain project status reports, highlighting progress, cost, schedule, quality, HSE, risks and required actions. Support continuous improvement in project delivery through contractor evaluations, lessons learned and development or improvement of project management procedures. Skills and Attributes: Excellent problem solving and analytical skills Experience with AutoCAD Experience using Smartsheet or Microsoft Projects or equivalent software Knowledge of safety requirements in an industrial environment Problem solving skills Excellent oral and written communication skills Be of high integrity Self-motivated Goal oriented Be able to multitask and work in high pressure situations for extended periods Qualification, Experience Diploma in Engineering or equivalent technical qualification 1 year experience in a technical capacity Ref: EngineerCCC Apply Now
